description:
[Skin Lab] Weapon attachments: what each gun accepts and what each attachment does. From the game's own attachment data (as Skin Lab uses it). Each attachment has `shortname`, `name`, `slot`
(`muzzle`, `sight`, `underbarrel`, `magazine`, `internal`, `targeting` - one attachment per slot), `description`,
`effects` (readable: `damage x0.75` = 25% less damage, `aimcone_hip +2` = wider hip-fire spread) and the raw
`stats` multipliers (`scalar`) and additions (`offset`). With `weapon`: that gun's `slots` and `accepts` (the
attachments that fit it). Without: every gun's accepted list plus every attachment. Which attachments a Rust gun takes and what each does (damage, recoil, zoom...).

weapon.description: Gun shortname or name; left out = every gun and every attachment.
